title: 菊花賞の後に・フクキタル、開☆眼

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Praise be! Grace has granted me fortune again on the chrysanthemum stage!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Did you see how my lucky stride blew right past all the other runners? I didn't even recognize myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All the luck I've gathered has set something aflame within me… Just what is becoming of me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Of course! There's no other explanation! I could never run like that normally.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then, today I must be the incarnation of happiness! Just like a plump, happy Buddha!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mwahahaha! This is the power of the gods! Luck will take me to the highest peaks!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If we simply ride this cresting wave of fortune, our future will certainly be assured!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer, what shall our next challenge be?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Shall we let our momentum carry us forward, smashing our way right through the Japan Cup and the Arima Kinen?!
choice_data_list: I-I don't think that's in the cards just yet…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh? Now that I've been reborn, those races are practically a walk in the park.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If not there, where do we go?
choice_data_list: Let's shoot for next year's Kinko Sho!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The Kinko Sho… Isn't that next spring? That's pretty far off…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Very well! This year's accomplishments will just have to satisfy me for now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On a hunch, I decide to give us a little breathing room. Matikanefukukitaru's behavior is beginning to concern me…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eh? What do you mean? I've reached enlightenment. I'm doing much better than simply "okay."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm off for my interview. I wonder what I should say… Maybe I'll tell them about meeting the gods! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She skips away with an uncharacteristically exaggerated spring in her step,

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru's actions only grow stranger afterwards.
